设备已关机，请先开机: The device is powered off. Turn it on to continue.
请连接电源，并按设备的 RST 或重新供电开机。: Connect power, then press the device RST button or reconnect its power supply.
设备连接已中断，重新连接后可开机；未保存的稿件仍保留在当前页面。: The connection was lost. Reconnect to power on; unsaved manuscript edits remain on this page.
屏幕已关闭，网络和蓝牙仍保持连接。点击开机即可继续使用。: The screen is off. Network and Bluetooth remain connected. Power on to continue.
正在恢复显示和设备设置，请稍候。: Restoring the display and settings. Please wait.
正在关闭屏幕，已保存的稿件和设置将保留。: Turning off the screen. Saved manuscripts and settings are preserved.
关闭屏幕并停止播放，网络和蓝牙保持连接。可通过网页再次开机；已保存的稿件和设置保: Turn off the screen and stop playback while keeping network and Bluetooth connected. Power on again from this page. Saved manuscripts and settings are preserved.
当前固件关机后无法远程开机，请按设备 RST 或重新供电。: This firmware cannot power on remotely after shutdown. Press the device RST button or reconnect power.
停止并回到开头；再次播放时按设置倒计时。: Stop and return to the beginning. The next Play uses the configured countdown.
按稿件库顺序切换到下一篇并停止，点击播放后开始；最后一篇时不可用。: Select the next manuscript in library order and stop. Press Play to start; unavailable on the last manuscript.
按稿件库顺序切换到上一篇并停止，点击播放后开始；第一篇时不可用。: Select the previous manuscript in library order and stop. Press Play to start; unavailable on the first manuscript.
此稿件的显示设置优先于设备默认值，自动保存到当前稿件库；恢复默认样式后使用设备设: This manuscript overrides the device bar visibility defaults and saves to the current library. Reset its style to inherit device settings.
标题居中；左侧日期时间，右侧播放状态和稿件信息。循环时显示次数，自动播放下一篇时: Centered title; date and time on the left, playback and manuscripts on the right. Loop mode shows the count; automatic advance shows the next manuscript. Fields that do not fit are hidden in full; reduce the font size to show more.
标题栏和状态栏字号: Header and status bar font size
同时调整标题栏高度和状态栏高度，最小 24 像素。正文第一行保持屏幕正中央；增加: Set the height of both bars together, with a minimum of 24 pixels. The first script line stays centered on the screen; increasing bar height does not add space to the single-line status bar.
同时调整标题栏和状态栏字号；高度不足时自动缩小到安全范围。状态栏最多显示 6 项: Set the font size of both bars together. Text is reduced to fit if the bars are too short. The status bar supports up to 6 fields; reduce the font size or remove fields if they do not fit.
Wi-Fi 已连接，设备热点即将关闭。请连接同一 Wi-Fi，打开下方地址。: Wi-Fi connected. The device hotspot will close shortly. Join the same Wi-Fi and open the address below.
蓝牙引导中，设备热点保持开启。: The device hotspot stays on during Bluetooth setup.
设置已保存。Wi-Fi 连接成功并取得 IP 后将关闭热点，请按屏幕地址继续访问: Settings saved. The hotspot will close after Wi-Fi connects and gets an IP address. Continue using the address shown on the device.
加粗正文笔画，保持字号、字间距和换行位置。: Thicken text strokes while preserving font size, spacing and line breaks.
SD 卡已有同名固件，未覆盖现有文件: A firmware file with this name already exists on the SD card; it was not overwritten
固件已校验并保存到 SD 卡，尚未安装: Firmware verified and saved to the SD card; not installed yet
将暂停当前播放并进入稿件编辑，屏幕会按其他控制端的使用状态决定是否休眠。: Playback will pause and the editor will open. The screen will stay awake if another controller is using it.
完成排序；每次拖动后自动保存: Finish reordering; every move is saved automatically
请勿断电或断开连接，完成后会自动恢复。: Keep the device powered and connected. It will reconnect automatically when finished.
请稍候，正在等待设备重新连接。: Please wait for the device to reconnect.
按 P4 的 RST 或重新上电可开机。: Press P4 RST or reconnect power to turn it on.
请稍候，启动完成后会自动恢复。: Please wait. Controls will resume after startup.
此设备不兼容当前提词器，请重新选择设备。: This device is not compatible with this teleprompter. Please choose another device.
有稿件无法确认原身份，已分配新 ID 并放在手动顺序末尾，请检查排序。: Some manuscripts could not be identified. They received new IDs at the end of the manual order. Please check their positions.
拖动排序，也可用上下方向键移动: Drag to reorder, or use the up and down arrow keys.
清空搜索后拖动排序: Clear the search to reorder manuscripts.
排序已被其他控制端修改，请刷新后重试: Another controller changed the order. Refresh and retry.
稿件列表已变化，请刷新后重新排序: The manuscript list changed. Refresh before reordering.
设备响应较慢，正在尝试重新连接。: The device is responding slowly. Reconnecting…
无法连接提词器，请检查 Wi-Fi 和设备电源，正在自动重连。: Cannot reach the teleprompter. Check Wi-Fi and device power. Reconnecting automatically…
蓝牙连接已断开，请重新连接设备。: Bluetooth disconnected. Reconnect to the device.
无法连接设备，请检查网络或蓝牙连接后重试。: Cannot reach the device. Check your network or Bluetooth connection and retry.
请求已中止，请重试。: The request was interrupted. Please retry.
设备返回的数据不完整，请重试。: The device response was incomplete. Please retry.
操作未完成，请重试；若仍失败，请重新连接设备。: The operation did not complete. Retry or reconnect to the device.
准备稿件，调整节奏，剩下的交给屏幕。: Prepare your script, set the pace, and start reading.
连接附近的 Teleprompter-P4，无需加入设备热点。: Connect to a nearby Teleprompter-P4 without joining its hotspot.
各入口共用设备设置；草稿只保存在当前浏览器。: All controllers share device settings. Drafts stay in this browser.
设备记录到欠压复位，已暂时关闭屏幕以保持连接。请检查连接后再尝试亮屏。: A low-voltage reset was detected. The display is off to keep the device connected. Check power before retrying.
发送后暂停在开头，准备好再播放。: Sending returns the script to the start, ready to play.
0 秒立即播放；暂停或回到开头可取消倒计时。: Set to 0 to play immediately. Pause or rewind cancels the countdown.
最低 10%，避免误关背光。松开滑块后自动保存。: Minimum 10% keeps the display visible. Release to save.
速度、字号、字间距、行距、倒计时、亮度和方向自动保存在设备上，重新打开网页或设备: Display settings are saved on the device and restored after reconnecting or restarting. Startup is paused.
草稿排版示意，实际显示以设备屏幕为准。: Layout preview. The device display is the final reference.
循环、对齐、边距、颜色和视线辅助: Loop, alignment, margins, color and reading guides
关闭循环时，读完自动暂停，再次播放从头开始。提词玻璃模式镜中向上滚动。正文和倒计: With looping off, playback stops at the end and Play restarts it. Glass mode scrolls upward in the reflection. Script and countdown are mirrored; title and status bar stay normal.
接入同一网络，在手机或电脑上控制: Control from a phone or computer on the same network
首次使用可连接 Teleprompter-P4 热点，密码 example-pa: For first setup, join Teleprompter-P4 with password example-password.
连接成功后，设备热点会自动关闭。请将手机切回路由器 Wi-Fi，按屏幕显示的 I: The device hotspot turns off after joining Wi-Fi. Rejoin your router and open the IP shown on the display. The hotspot returns if reconnection keeps failing.
密码仅发送给设备，不保存在浏览器草稿中，也不会回显。: The password is sent only to the device. It is never included in drafts or displayed again.
0 为关闭，最多 86400 秒（24 小时）。播放或倒计时期间不休眠。发送稿件: 0 disables sleep; maximum 86400 seconds (24 hours). Playback and countdown prevent sleep. Sending a script or changing settings wakes the screen; polling does not.
支持中文：热点最多 32 字节，蓝牙最多 29 字节，一个汉字通常占 3 字节。: Unicode names supported: hotspot up to 32 UTF-8 bytes, Bluetooth up to 29. Names take effect after restart. Hotspot password remains example-password.
休眠前会显示提示，网络保持连接，可随时唤醒。重启前会显示提示，重启后需要重新发送: Sleep and restart show a notice first. Networking stays on during sleep. Resend the script after restarting. Unplugging power or pressing RST cannot show a notice first.
热点与路由器局域网共用此控制台。: The hotspot and router LAN use this same controller.
草稿自动保存在当前浏览器 · 设备重启后需重新发送稿件: Drafts save in this browser · Resend after device restart
状态栏供设置者查看，保持正常方向；不跟随正文镜像、颜色或字号。: The status bar is for the operator. It keeps its normal direction, color and font size.

尚未连接设备，草稿已保留: Device disconnected. Your draft is retained.

连接未成功，请检查 Wi-Fi 名称、密码及信号。: Connection failed. Check the Wi-Fi name, password and signal.
设备热点已关闭，正在使用路由器网络。: Device hotspot is off. Connected through the router.
局域网控制请另开设备屏幕上的 http://IP 地址。此 HTTPS 页面通过: For LAN control, open the device's http://IP address. This HTTPS page controls nearby devices via Bluetooth.
蓝牙可控制播放并发送稿件；读取稿件请使用局域网。: Bluetooth supports playback and script upload. Use LAN to read the device script.
当前浏览器未提供 Web Bluetooth，请换用支持的 Chrome / E: Web Bluetooth is unavailable in this browser. Use a supported Chrome or Edge browser.
蓝牙需要 HTTPS 或本机 localhost。局域网 HTTP 页面请使用: Bluetooth requires HTTPS or localhost. Use Wi-Fi control on a LAN HTTP page.

稿件超过 8192 字节，请缩短后再发送。: Script exceeds 8192 bytes. Shorten it before sending.
稿件已发送，按“播放”开始滚动: Script sent. Press Play to start scrolling.

屏幕还没有稿件，请先发送。: No script on the device. Send one first.

设备正在重启，稍后重新连接并发送稿件。: Device restarting. Reconnect and resend the script.

名称已保存，重启后生效。当前热点：: Names saved; restart to apply. Active hotspot:
各入口共用设备设置，约每 1.5 秒同步。: All controllers share device settings, refreshed about every 1.5 seconds.
设备固件暂不支持设备设置: Device firmware does not support these settings
自动休眠请输入 0–86400 之间的整数秒数: Sleep timeout must be an integer between 0 and 86400 seconds
名称不能为空或带首尾空格；热点最多 32 字节，蓝牙最多 29 字节: Names must not be empty or have leading/trailing spaces. Hotspot: 32 bytes max; Bluetooth: 29.
设置已保存。自动休眠立即生效，名称重启后生效。: Saved. Sleep settings apply now; names apply after restart.
文件过大，请导入 8192 字节以内的 UTF-8 文本。: File too large. Import UTF-8 text within 8192 bytes.
稿件超过 8192 字节，请缩短后再导入。: Script exceeds 8192 bytes. Shorten it before importing.
请选择 UTF-8 文本文件，文件中不能包含空字符。: Choose UTF-8 text without null characters.
导入文件会覆盖当前草稿；可以先取消并导出备份。: Import replaces the current draft. Cancel and export a backup if needed.
只清空当前编辑区，屏幕上的稿件保持不变。: Only clears this editor. The device script is unchanged.
请输入 8–63 位 Wi-Fi 密码；无密码网络请勾选相应选项: Enter an 8–63 character password, or select Open network.
设置已保存。连接成功后热点会关闭，请按屏幕 IP 重新打开控制台。: Saved. The hotspot turns off after joining Wi-Fi. Reopen the controller using the displayed IP.
设备将断开路由器并恢复: The device will disconnect from the router and restore the
热点。当前控制页面可能暂时断开。: hotspot. This controller may briefly disconnect.

语言已保存并同步到设备: Language saved and synchronized to the device
已切换本页语言，连接设备后以设备设置为准: Page language changed. Device language takes precedence after connecting.
连接设备热点时，请使用你设置的热点密码；出厂密码为 example-passwo: Connect to the device hotspot using your saved password. The factory password is example-password.
语言、休眠、名称与热点密码: Language, sleep, names and hotspot password
留空保持原密码: Leave blank to keep the current password
8–63 位英文字母、数字或符号。密码不会回显；保存后重启生效，重新连接热点时使: Use 8–63 ASCII letters, digits or symbols. The saved password is never displayed. Restart to apply it, then reconnect using the new password.
名称支持中文：热点最多 32 字节，蓝牙最多 29 字节，一个汉字通常占 3 字: Names support Chinese: up to 32 bytes for the hotspot and 29 for Bluetooth. A Chinese character usually uses 3 bytes. 名称或热点密码已保存，重启后生效。当前热点：: Names or hotspot password saved. Restart to apply. Current hotspot:

设置已保存。名称和热点密码重启后生效，其余设置立即生效。: Saved. Restart to apply names and the hotspot password; other settings apply immediately.
标题也是 txt 文件名: The title is the txt filename
三端读取同一设备，稿件与独立样式保存在 SD 卡。: All controllers read the same device. Scripts and their styles are saved on the SD card.
稿件保存于 SD 卡 · 系统配置保存于设备 · 浏览器不持久保存: Scripts on SD card · System settings on device · No browser persistence
保存到 SD 卡后，所有控制端均可读取。: After saving to the SD card, all controllers can read this script.
正在播放稿件的排版预览，实际显示以设备屏幕为准。: Layout preview of the active script. Refer to the device screen for playback.
当前稿件的阅读样式自动保存到同名 JSON；亮度和屏幕方向保存为设备配置。: Reading style is saved to this script’s JSON file. Brightness and orientation are device settings.
休眠前会显示提示，网络保持连接，可随时唤醒。重启前会显示提示，重启后可从 SD: Sleep and restart show a notice first. Network stays connected during sleep. After restarting, select a script from the SD card. Unplugging power or pressing RST cannot show a notice in advance.
蓝牙可管理 SD 卡稿件与控制播放。: Bluetooth manages SD card scripts and playback.
设备会先显示重启提示。已保存的 SD 卡稿件与系统配置保留。: The device will show a restart notice. Saved SD card scripts and system settings are retained.
设备正在重启，稍后重新连接并选择稿件。: Restarting. Reconnect and select a script shortly.
标题无效，请勿使用路径或特殊文件名字符: Invalid title. Avoid paths and special filename characters.
其他控制端已修改，请重新读取后再保存: Changed by another controller. Reload before saving.
正文需为 8192 字节以内的 UTF-8 文本: Text must be UTF-8 and no larger than 8192 bytes
样式文件无效，请在编辑页重置样式: Invalid style file. Reset the style in the editor.
稿件不存在、编码不正确或超过大小限制: Script missing, invalid encoding, or too large
SD 卡读写失败，原稿件已保留: SD card operation failed. The previous script was retained.
请升级设备固件后使用稿件库: Update device firmware to use the library
未保存的内容只在当前页面内存中，离开后不会保存。: Unsaved edits exist only in this page’s memory and will be lost when you leave.

暂无稿件，可新建或将 txt 文件放入 SD 卡的 teleprompter 文: No scripts yet. Create one or put txt files in the SD card’s teleprompter folder.
请插入 SD 卡后点击刷新，不会自动格式化。: Insert an SD card and refresh. The device will not format it.
同时删除同名样式文件。此操作不可撤销。: The matching style file will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
播放设置自动保存到当前稿件；亮度和方向保存到设备。编辑页只修改正文。: Playback settings save to the current script. Brightness and orientation save to the device. The editor changes text only.
首次蓝牙连接需要选择设备；浏览器保留授权时会尝试自动重连。不要同时用多个蓝牙页面: Choose the device on first connection. Automatic reconnection is attempted when the browser retains permission. Use one Bluetooth page per device.
休眠设为 0 即关闭。热点名称、密码和蓝牙名称修改后重启生效，其他设备设置立即生: Set sleep to 0 to disable it. Hotspot name, password and Bluetooth name apply after restarting; other device settings apply immediately.
热点密码留空不改。密码为 8–63 位英文字母、数字或符号，不会回显。: Leave the hotspot password blank to keep it. Use 8–63 ASCII characters; it is never displayed.
Ctrl + Enter 保存稿件，Alt + Space 播放或暂停。: Ctrl + Enter saves text. Alt + Space plays or pauses.
首次连接请选择设备，后续会尝试自动重连。: Choose a device on first connection; later connections are retried automatically.
样式文件无效，请在播放页恢复默认样式: The style file is invalid. Reset it on the playback page.
名称或密码已保存，重启后生效。: Name or password saved. Restart to apply.
其他端已修改，请重新读取: Changed on another controller. Reload to continue.
蓝牙操作超时，请稍后重试: Bluetooth operation timed out. Try again shortly.
蓝牙连接暂未完成，正在自动重试。请保持设备靠近。: Bluetooth connection incomplete. Retrying automatically; keep the device nearby.
倒退：连续点击依次切换 ×1 至 ×8；点击播放恢复正常速度。: Rewind: click repeatedly for ×1 to ×8. Press Play for normal speed.

回到开头并暂停；再次播放时按设置倒计时。: Return to start and pause. The next Play uses the countdown.
正常播放的滚动速度；快进和倒退倍率独立计算。: Normal scrolling speed; shuttle multipliers are applied separately.
调整屏幕文字大小，可拖动滑块或直接输入数值。: Drag the slider or enter a value to adjust text size.
从开头播放时倒计时；暂停后继续播放不会重复倒计时。: Countdown when starting from the beginning; resuming does not repeat it.
最低亮度为 10%；休眠时保留低亮度状态提示。: Minimum brightness is 10%. Sleep keeps a dim status screen.
横屏以充电口朝下为正向，竖屏以充电口朝右为正向。: Normal landscape has the charging port at the bottom; portrait has it on the right.
为提词玻璃上下翻转正文与倒计时，设备状态提示保持正常方向。: Flip the script and countdown vertically for the glass. Device notices stay upright.
框住第一行阅读位置，随屏幕方向和提词玻璃设置调整。: Frame the first reading line, respecting orientation and glass reflection.
突出阅读提示区域，降低区域外文字亮度。: Highlight the reading band and dim text outside it.

同时调整正文左右两侧的留白。: Adjust both left and right margins.

设置正文和播放倒计时颜色。: Set the script and countdown color.
将当前稿件的阅读样式恢复为设备默认值。: Reset this script to the device default reading style.

显示或隐藏屏幕顶部标题与底部状态栏。: Show or hide the screen title and footer.

暂停播放并进入低亮度休眠，保留状态提示。: Pause and enter dim sleep with a status message.
保存的稿件和配置保留，重启期间会暂时断开连接。: Saved scripts and settings are kept. Connection drops briefly during restart.

启动时自动检查 SD 卡并更新: Check SD card and update automatically at startup
更新完成后设备会自动重启。: The device will restart after the update.
蓝牙传输较慢，请保持页面打开。: Bluetooth transfer is slower. Keep this page open.
固件不属于此提词器项目: This firmware is for a different project.
固件校验失败，已保留原版本: Firmware verification failed. Original version retained.
设备尚在启动，请稍后重试: Device is starting. Try again shortly.
此固件曾启动失败，已阻止重复更新: This firmware failed to boot previously. Repeat update blocked.
新固件启动失败，已回退原版本: New firmware failed to boot. Previous version restored.
上传超时，已取消: Upload timed out and was cancelled.
相邻字形边缘之间的距离，0 表示贴紧；正文中的空格仍会保留。: Gap between glyph edges. Zero removes the gap; typed spaces are preserved.
两行字形区域之间的距离，0 表示贴紧，不包含字体自带留白。: Gap between text rows. Zero removes extra font whitespace.
正常亮度最低为 10%；休眠时进一步调暗当前画面，唤醒后恢复。: Normal brightness starts at 10%. Sleep dims the current screen further; waking restores it.
暂停播放并调暗当前画面；唤醒后恢复原亮度。: Pause and dim the current screen. Wake to restore brightness.
只安装较新版本；已安装或曾启动失败的版本不会重复更新。: Only newer versions are installed. Installed and previously failed builds are skipped.
将固件放到 SD 卡根目录的 firmware 文件夹；文件名中的版本必须与固件: Place firmware in the SD card firmware folder. Its filename version must match the embedded version.
无法打开蓝牙选择器，请检查蓝牙和浏览器权限。: Could not open the Bluetooth chooser. Check Bluetooth and browser permissions.
固件信息在传输中发生变化，请重新选择文件: Firmware metadata changed during transfer. Select the file again.
无法保存更新记录，已保留原版本: Could not save the update record. Original firmware retained.
无法切换固件，已保留原版本: Could not activate the new firmware. Original firmware retained.
无法开始固件更新，请稍后重试: Could not start the update. Try again later.
无法读取 SD 卡固件目录: Could not access the SD card firmware folder.
更新会话已结束，请重新开始: The update session has ended. Start again.
固件传输位置不匹配，请重新开始: Firmware transfer position does not match. Start again.
请先从稿件库选择稿件: Select a script from the library first
正常亮度最低为 10%；休眠会关闭背光，唤醒后恢复。: Normal brightness starts at 10%. Sleep turns off the backlight; wake restores it.
暂停播放，逐渐调暗后关闭背光；唤醒后恢复原亮度。: Pause, dim and turn off the backlight. Wake restores the saved brightness.
从 SD 卡的 firmware 文件夹查找新版固件，确认版本后安装；不会格式化: Find a newer firmware in the SD card's firmware folder and confirm before installing. This does not format or check the card's health.
软件关机后屏幕、Wi-Fi 和蓝牙控制将关闭。请按 P4 的 RST 或重新上电: Software shutdown turns off the screen, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth control. Press P4 RST or reconnect power to start again. Saved scripts and settings are retained.
设备正在关机。按 P4 的 RST 或重新上电可开机。: Shutting down. Press P4 RST or reconnect power to start again.
断开后停止自动重连，设备保持当前播放状态。需要控制时可重新连接。: Automatic reconnection will stop. The device keeps its current playback state. Connect again when you need control.
将清除当前稿件的独立样式，恢复设备默认阅读设置。稿件正文保持不变。: Remove this script's saved style and restore the device's default reading settings. The script text stays unchanged.
标记屏幕正中央的阅读位置，正文第一行从这里开始。: Mark the reading position at the screen center, where the first line starts.
输入或粘贴正文，也可导入 TXT 文件。: Type or paste your script, or import a TXT file.
按稿件库顺序切换并播放下一篇，使用该稿件的样式和倒计时；最后一篇时不可用。: Play the next script in library order with its saved style and countdown. Unavailable on the last script.
导入文件会替换编辑框中的正文，保存后才会写入 SD 卡。: Import replaces the editor text. The SD card is updated only when you save.
固件文件名：teleprompter-p4-YYYYMMDD.N.bin；版本须: Filename: teleprompter-p4-YYYYMMDD.N.bin. The version must match the version inside the file.
启动时检查 SD 卡的 firmware 文件夹，只安装较新版本；已安装或曾启动: Check the SD card firmware folder at startup and install newer versions only. Installed or previously failed versions are not retried.
选择电脑或手机中的固件文件，确认版本后更新设备。: Choose a firmware file on your computer or phone, then confirm its version to update the device.
倒退：仅在播放中可用；每次确认后点击，依次切换 ×1 至 ×8，再回到 ×1。暂: Reverse: available only while playing. Each confirmed click cycles from ×1 to ×8, then back to ×1. Unavailable while paused, stopped or counting down. Play restores normal speed.
快进：仅在播放中可用；每次确认后点击，依次切换 ×1 至 ×8，再回到 ×1。暂: Fast forward: available only while playing. Each confirmed click cycles from ×1 to ×8, then back to ×1. Unavailable while paused, stopped or counting down. Play restores normal speed.
每篇正文最多 8 KB（8192 个 UTF-8 字节），约 2700 个常见汉: Each script allows up to 8 KB (8192 UTF-8 bytes), about 2700 common Chinese characters. Punctuation, line breaks and emoji also count. This is not the total SD card capacity.
浏览器报告蓝牙不可用，请开启系统蓝牙并检查权限，或使用局域网控制。: Bluetooth is unavailable. Turn it on and check permissions, or use LAN control.
请在浏览器弹出的设备窗口中选择提词器。: Choose the prompter in the browser's device picker.
浏览器未返回蓝牙选择结果。如未出现设备窗口，请更换浏览器或使用局域网控制。: The browser has not returned a device selection. If no picker appeared, try another browser or LAN control.
当前浏览器未实现完整的蓝牙连接功能，请更换浏览器或使用局域网控制。: This browser does not fully implement Bluetooth connections. Try another browser or LAN control.
已取消选择，可重新连接。: Selection cancelled. You can connect again.
按稿件库顺序切换并播放上一篇，使用该稿件的样式和倒计时；第一篇时不可用。: Play the previous script in library order with its saved style and countdown. Unavailable on the first script.
请更新设备固件以支持蓝牙配置 Wi-Fi: Update device firmware to configure Wi-Fi over Bluetooth
Wi-Fi 配置无效，请检查名称和密码: Invalid Wi-Fi settings. Check the network name and password
Wi-Fi 设置失败，请重试: Could not save Wi-Fi settings. Try again
名称从前到后，时间从早到晚: Names A to Z; dates oldest first
名称从后到前，时间从晚到早: Names Z to A; dates newest first
排序决定上一稿和下一稿的顺序: Sorting sets the previous and next script order
将删除所选稿件及同名样式文件，无法撤销。: Selected scripts and their style files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
连接已变化，请重新检查稿件: Connection changed. Check the library again.
设备正在更新，请等待完成: The device is updating. Please wait until it finishes.
设备暂忙，请稍后重试: The device is busy. Please try again shortly.
设备处理请求失败，请稍后重试: The device could not process the request. Please try again shortly.
此稿件正在设备上播放: This manuscript is playing on the device.
设备当前载入的稿件: The manuscript currently loaded on the device.
按当前排序，将播放的上一篇稿件: The previous manuscript in the current playback order.
按当前排序，将播放的下一篇稿件: The next manuscript in the current playback order.
设备内存暂不足，请稍后重试: The device is low on memory. Please try again shortly.
当前稿件播完后，按稿件库排序播放下一篇，并使用下一篇的样式和倒计时。循环当前稿开: When the current script ends, play the next in library order with its style and countdown. Loop takes priority. Stop after the last script.
预览字体加载失败，请连接互联网后重试；真机显示不受影响。: Preview font could not load. Connect to the internet and retry; the device display is unaffected.
设备正在由另一台设备控制，请先关闭原控制页面，约 20 秒后重试。: Another device is controlling the prompter. Close its page and retry in about 20 seconds.
每次只启用一种连接方式，且仅允许一台设备控制。: Use one connection mode and one controller at a time.
正在切换连接方式，请根据设备屏幕显示的新入口重新连接。: Switching connection. Reconnect using the new address on the device.
当前连接将在 5 秒后断开。请按设备屏幕上的新入口重新连接。: This connection will close in 5 seconds. Reconnect using the new entry on the device.
固件服务器暂不可用，请稍后重试: Firmware server unavailable. Please retry later.
请等待当前固件版本读取完成: Wait for the current firmware version to load
下载校验完成后安装，设备会自动重启。: The download is verified before installation. The device will restart automatically.
固件下载超时，请检查网络后重试。: Firmware download timed out. Check your network and retry.
检查更新超时，请稍后重试。: Update check timed out. Please retry shortly.
设备连接已变化，请重新检查更新: The device connection changed. Check for updates again.
开机从 SD 卡自动更新: Update from SD card on startup
重启后请连接设备热点，重新选择连接方式。: After restarting, connect to the device hotspot and choose a connection mode again.
请勿断电或断开连接，完成后设备会重启。: Keep the device powered and connected. It will restart when finished.
请设置热点密码，或开启无需密码: Set a hotspot password or enable password-free access
仅允许一台设备控制；无人连接时开放热点引导。: One controller at a time. The hotspot guide opens when no controller is connected.
Wi-Fi 已连接。请打开下方控制台地址，连接成功后关闭设备热点。: Wi-Fi connected. Open the controller below; the hotspot closes once the controller connects.
设置已保存。连接 Wi-Fi 后，请用局域网地址打开控制台；连接成功后关闭设备热: Settings saved. Join Wi-Fi and open the LAN controller; the hotspot closes when the controller connects.
联网后自动检查更新: Automatically check for updates when online
联网后检查服务器版本，不会自动安装。: Check the server version when online. Updates are never installed automatically.
当前浏览器离线；本地文件和 SD 卡更新仍可使用。: This browser is offline. Local file and SD card updates remain available.
暂时无法访问更新服务器；本地文件和 SD 卡更新仍可使用。: The update server is unreachable. Local file and SD card updates remain available.
暂时无法访问更新服务器；请检查当前浏览器的网络后重试。: The update server is unreachable. Check this browser’s network and retry.
点击在线更新后确认安装: Select Online update to review and install
SD 卡已安全弹出，可取出存储卡: SD card ejected safely. You can remove it.
SD 卡不可用，请检查是否插入: SD card unavailable. Check that it is inserted.
将删除整张 SD 卡上的所有文件，包括稿件、样式和固件，无法恢复。: This permanently deletes every file on the SD card, including manuscripts, styles and firmware.
请确认重要文件已备份。设备系统设置不会被删除。: Make sure important files are backed up. Device system settings are preserved.
将停止播放并关闭存储卡。重新读取后才能继续使用稿件。: Playback stops and the card is unmounted. Mount it again to use manuscripts.
SD 卡格式化失败，请重新插入后检查: SD card format failed. Reinsert the card and check it.
SD 卡弹出失败，请重试: Could not eject the SD card. Retry.
SD 卡正在维护，请稍候: SD card maintenance is in progress. Please wait.
请先确认此操作会清空整张 SD 卡: Confirm that this operation erases the entire SD card.
浏览器联网且设备连接正常时自动检查服务器版本，只提示，不会自动下载或安装。: Check server versions when the browser and device are online. Only notify; never download or install automatically.
重新挂载已弹出或重新插入的 SD 卡。: Mount an ejected or reinserted SD card.
停止播放并卸载 SD 卡，完成后可取出。: Stop playback and unmount the SD card. Remove it once completed.
清空整张 SD 卡上的所有文件，无法恢复。: Permanently erase all files on the SD card.
标题始终居中；左侧日期时间，右侧播放状态。底栏左侧为下一篇，右侧为运行参数。: The title stays centered, with date/time on the left and playback state on the right. The footer shows the next manuscript on the left and runtime data on the right.
显示屏幕顶部的信息栏；待机引导页始终保留标题栏。: Show the screen header. The setup guide always keeps its header.
显示屏幕底部的信息栏；待机引导页始终隐藏状态栏。: Show the screen footer. The setup guide always hides its footer.
调整标题栏高度，单位为设备屏幕像素；正文阅读中心保持不变。: Header height in device pixels. The reading center stays fixed.
调整状态栏高度。显示项目较多时可增加高度；超出空间的内容显示省略号。: Increase the footer height to fit more information. Overflow is truncated with an ellipsis.
帧率是正文实际提交帧数；抖动是提交帧间隔的标准差，均按两秒窗口统计。: Frame rate counts submitted text frames. Jitter is the standard deviation of frame intervals, measured over two seconds.
已就绪的文字分块数 / 分块缓冲容量，不代表整篇稿件已缓存。: Ready text tiles / tile capacity. This does not mean the entire manuscript is cached.
此稿件的显示设置优先于设备默认值，自动保存到 SD 卡；恢复默认样式后使用设备设: This manuscript overrides the device bar visibility defaults and saves to the SD card. Reset its style to inherit the device settings.
预览字体暂未加载完成，正在重试；真机显示不受影响。: The preview font is not ready. Retrying; the device display is unaffected.
网页控制名额已占用，请关闭原网页，约 20 秒后重试；蓝牙可独立连接。: The web controller slot is occupied. Close its page and retry in about 20 seconds; Bluetooth can connect independently.
正在切换网络方式，蓝牙连接不受影响。: Switching the network connection. Bluetooth stays connected.
网页连接可能在 5 秒后断开，蓝牙保持连接。请从新的网络入口继续。: The web connection may close in 5 seconds. Bluetooth stays connected. Continue using the new network address.
蓝牙与网页可同时控制，各限一台；网页使用热点或 Wi-Fi。: One Bluetooth and one web controller can work together. The web connection uses either the hotspot or Wi-Fi.
请在设备列表中选择提词器。: Choose your prompter from the device list.
未完成设备选择，请关闭选择窗口后重试。: Device selection is incomplete. Close the picker and try again.
请在系统设置中允许此 App 使用蓝牙和附近设备。: Allow this app to use Bluetooth and nearby devices in system settings.
蓝牙未开启，请先开启手机蓝牙。: Turn on your phone's Bluetooth first.
此设备不支持蓝牙低功耗连接，请使用支持蓝牙的手机。: This device does not support Bluetooth Low Energy. Use a phone with Bluetooth support.
0 表示不自动关机；播放和升级期间不计时，关机后需按 RST 或重新供电: 0 disables automatic shutdown. Playback and updates prevent shutdown. Press RST or reconnect power to start again.
自动关机请输入 0–86400 之间的整数秒数: Shutdown timeout must be an integer between 0 and 86400 seconds
设备设置已保存，自动休眠与自动关机立即生效。: Settings saved. Automatic sleep and shutdown take effect immediately.
热点、Wi-Fi 与蓝牙同时开放，多个设备可共同控制。: Hotspot, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth remain available together for multiple controllers.
Wi-Fi 已连接，设备热点和蓝牙保持可用。可通过任一入口控制。: Wi-Fi connected. The device hotspot and Bluetooth remain available. Use any connection.
设置已保存。Wi-Fi、设备热点和蓝牙可同时使用。: Saved. Wi-Fi, the device hotspot and Bluetooth can be used together.
标题居中；左侧日期时间，右侧播放状态和稿件信息。循环时显示次数，自动播放下一篇时: Centered title; date and time on the left, playback and manuscripts on the right. Loop mode shows the count; automatic advance shows the next manuscript.
顶部独立留白，最小 24 像素；不影响底部留白。正文第一行保持屏幕正中央。: Independent top margin, at least 24 pixels. The first line stays at the physical screen center.
底部独立留白，最小 24 像素；不影响顶部留白。空间不足时截断显示。: Independent bottom margin, at least 24 pixels. Overflow is truncated.
标题、日期、设备名称和播放状态使用统一字号、颜色；高度不足时自动缩小到安全范围。: Header information shares one font size and color. Text shrinks to fit short bars.
调整状态栏文字大小。项目过多时可增大栏高或关闭部分项目。: Set status text size. Increase the height or hide fields if space is limited.
相对于当前速度的播放倍率，正常播放为 x1；倒退显示负倍率。: Playback multiplier relative to the set speed. Normal playback is x1; reverse is negative.
PSRAM 可用容量 / 总容量，不包含独立的内部 RAM。: Available / total PSRAM; excludes separate internal RAM.
设备热点接口的 MAC 地址。: MAC address of the device hotspot interface.
显示当前设备热点名称，与同栏其他文字使用相同字号和颜色。: Show the active hotspot name with the same size and color as other header text.
仅在循环播放开启时显示已完成的循环次数。: Show completed loops only when looping is enabled.
仅在自动播放下一篇开启且存在下一篇稿件时显示。: Show only when automatic advance is enabled and a next manuscript exists.
不循环时，按稿件库当前顺序显示上一篇稿件。: Show the previous manuscript in library order when not looping.
按正文实际提交帧率、区域大小和 RGB565 每像素 16 位计算的等效像素码率: Equivalent pixel rate from submitted frames, text area and RGB565 at 16 bits per pixel; not network traffic or compressed video bitrate.
本次开机以来成功提交的正文绘制帧数。: Text frames successfully submitted since boot.
正文连续播放时超过预期提交间隔的帧数；考虑低速下的整数像素步进，不代表 LCD: Frames submitted late during continuous playback, accounting for integer pixel steps at low speed. Not a measure of LCD hardware drops.
正文播放结束后自动从开头继续；开启后关闭自动播放下一篇。: Repeat the manuscript from the start. Enabling this disables automatic advance.
当前稿件播完后，按稿件库排序播放下一篇，并使用下一篇的样式和倒计时；开启后关闭循: Play the next manuscript in library order with its own style and countdown. Disables looping; stops after the last manuscript.
无操作达到此时间后自动关机；0 表示关闭。播放和升级期间不计时，关机后需按 RS: Shut down after this period without activity; 0 disables automatic shutdown. Playback and updates do not count. Press RST or reconnect power to turn the device on.
网络地址未能应用，已恢复原配置，请检查后重试。: The address change failed and the previous settings were restored. Check them and try again.
修改地址和本地域名需要更新设备固件。: Update the device firmware to edit IP addresses and the local hostname.
网络地址已更新，请重新连接后打开：: The network address has changed. Reconnect, then open:
请输入有效的热点 IPv4 地址: Enter a valid hotspot IPv4 address.
本地域名只能包含字母、数字和连字符，最多 63 位: Use up to 63 letters, digits or hyphens for the local hostname.
请填写有效的局域网 IP、子网掩码、网关和 DNS: Enter a valid LAN IP, subnet mask, gateway and DNS server.
子网掩码必须连续，且至少保留两个可用主机地址: The subnet mask must be contiguous and allow at least two usable host addresses.
局域网 IP 和网关必须处于同一网段，且不能相同: The LAN IP and gateway must be different addresses in the same subnet.
请输入有效的 DNS 地址: Enter a valid DNS server address.
热点与局域网不能使用重叠的网段: The hotspot and LAN subnets must not overlap.
网络地址无效，请检查 IP、网关、子网掩码和本地域名: Check the IP addresses, gateway, subnet mask and local hostname.
请通过热点或局域网修改域名和 IP；蓝牙可修改 Wi-Fi 名称和密码: Use the hotspot or LAN to change the hostname and IP addresses. Bluetooth can change the Wi-Fi name and password.
当前网络连接可能暂时中断。请记下新地址，保存后重新连接设备。: The current connection may close temporarily. Note the new address and reconnect after saving.
修改设备热点的实际 IPv4 地址；保存后需重新连接热点。热点子网掩码固定为 2: Change the hotspot's IPv4 address. Reconnect after saving. Its subnet mask is fixed at 255.255.255.0.
开启固定局域网 IP 后可修改。关闭时由路由器自动分配地址。: Enable Static LAN IP to edit this address. Otherwise the router assigns it automatically.
输入字母、数字或连字符，自动添加 .local。通过 mDNS 访问；无法解析时: Use letters, digits or hyphens; .local is added automatically. Uses mDNS; the IP address remains available if resolution fails.
默认自动获取 IP。固定 IP 必须处于路由器网段，且未被其他设备使用。: IP addresses are assigned automatically by default. A static IP must be unused and in the router's subnet.
默认沿用当前网络的网关、子网掩码和 DNS；更换网络后请先自动获取一次，或在此手: Defaults to the current gateway, subnet mask and DNS. On a new network, obtain them automatically first or enter them here.
恢复由路由器自动分配 IP，保留已保存的本地域名。: Let the router assign an IP again. Keep the saved local hostname.
修改后自动保存热点 IP，可能需要重新连接热点。热点地址固定，子网掩码为 255: The hotspot IP is saved automatically after editing. You may need to reconnect. The subnet mask is fixed at 255.255.255.0.
修改后自动保存为固定 IP，沿用当前网络的网关、子网掩码和 DNS。请使用同网段: Editing saves a static IP with the current gateway, subnet mask and DNS. Choose an unused address in the same subnet. Use the adjacent button to restore automatic assignment.
输入字母、数字或连字符，自动添加 .local，修改后单独保存，不改变 IP。通: Use letters, digits or hyphens; .local is added automatically. The hostname saves independently without changing the IP. Use the IP if mDNS resolution is unavailable.
尚未获取网络参数，请先连接 Wi-Fi 后再修改局域网 IP: Connect to Wi-Fi to obtain network parameters before editing the LAN IP.
请输入有效的局域网 IPv4 地址: Enter a valid LAN IPv4 address.
可前往设备设置查看并安装；不会自动下载或安装。: Open device settings to review and install it. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
默认开启。浏览器联网且设备连接正常时检查服务器版本，每次打开控制台发现新版时提示: Enabled by default. When the browser is online and connected to the device, check the server and notify once each time the console is opened if a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
恢复出厂设置未能启动，请重试: Could not start the factory reset. Please retry.
恢复机器配置，保留 SD 卡稿件和独立样式。: Reset device settings. Keep SD card manuscripts and their styles.
请先更新设备固件以使用恢复出厂设置。: Update the device firmware to use factory reset.
将恢复设备、网络、播放默认值和更新偏好，并重启设备。SD 卡中的稿件、独立样式和: Restore device, network, default playback and update settings, then restart. Keep SD card manuscripts, their styles and order files. Reconnect to the device hotspot after restarting.
稿件和独立样式保留；重启后请重新连接设备热点。: Manuscripts and their styles are kept. Reconnect to the device hotspot after restarting.
启用本地域名时请填写域名: Enter a hostname before enabling it
部分手机或网络不支持本地域名，可能无法访问。遇到这种情况，请使用设备显示的 IP: Some phones or networks do not support local hostnames. If the page cannot be opened, use the IP address shown on the device.
固件已更新。请先保存或放弃未保存的稿件，再刷新页面。: Firmware updated. Save or discard your unsaved manuscript before reloading the page.
未保存的稿件修改将丢失。建议先保存稿件，再刷新。: Unsaved manuscript changes will be lost. Save your manuscript before reloading.
设备重启后会尝试自动重连并刷新页面。: After restarting, the controller will try to reconnect and reload the page.
此版本为强制更新，完成更新后才能继续使用。: This update is required. Install it to continue using the controller.
更新未完成，请重试。完成更新后才能继续使用。: The update did not finish. Retry the update to continue.
关闭后不提醒普通更新；服务器要求的强制更新仍会检查。: Disables optional update prompts. Required server updates will still be checked.
存储读写失败，请保留当前草稿并重试: Storage read/write failed. Keep your draft and retry.
稿件存储已切换，请刷新列表后重新操作；未保存的正文仍保留: Manuscript storage changed. Refresh the library and retry. Your unsaved draft is retained.
存储空间不足，请先导出或删除不需要的稿件: Storage is full. Back up or delete unneeded manuscripts first.
SD 卡和内置存储均不可用，请保留当前草稿: Neither SD nor internal storage is available. Keep your current draft.
内置存储不可用，已有分区数据未被清空: Internal storage is unavailable. Existing partition data has been preserved.
正在使用内置存储，稿件与 SD 卡分开保存；可在设置中切换。: Using internal storage. Manuscripts are separate from the SD library. Switch in Settings.
稿件存储不可用，请在设置中重新读取: Manuscript storage is unavailable. Retry in Settings.
稿件存储不可用，请在设置中重新读取。: Manuscript storage is unavailable. Retry in Settings.
内置稿件库为空，可新建或导入文稿。: Internal library is empty. Create or import a manuscript.
导入文件会替换编辑框中的正文，保存后才会写入当前稿件库。: Import replaces the editor text. Save to write it to the current library.
将停止当前提词。两处稿件独立保存，不会自动复制或覆盖。: Current prompting will stop. The libraries are separate; nothing will be copied or overwritten automatically.
将停止播放并关闭存储卡。随后将切换到内置稿件库，SD 卡原稿件保留。: Stop playback and unmount the SD card. Switch to the internal library while preserving SD manuscripts.
SD 卡不可用，请检查插卡、文件系统或读卡连接: SD card unavailable. Check insertion, filesystem and card connection.
SD 卡为 exFAT，当前支持 FAT32；原卡数据保留，可先使用内置存储: This SD card uses exFAT. FAT32 is supported. Card data is preserved; use internal storage for now.
内置存储保留部分空间用于安全写入和维护；可用容量已扣除预留空间。: Some internal space is reserved for safe writes and maintenance. Available capacity excludes this reserve.
exFAT 读取失败，原卡数据保留，可先使用内置存储: Could not read the exFAT card. Card data is preserved; use internal storage for now.
标题居中；日期、时间、播放时间码三选一，显示在左上角。上一篇与下一篇二选一。循环: Centered title; choose date, clock or playback timecode for the upper left. Choose either previous or next manuscript. Loop count appears at the upper right when looping; next manuscript appears in auto-next mode.
与联网后自动检查更新互斥，开启此项会关闭另一项；手动更新不受影响。: Mutually exclusive with automatic online checks. Enabling this turns the other option off. Manual updates remain available.
与开机从 SD 卡自动更新互斥，开启此项会关闭另一项。关闭后不提醒普通更新；服务: Mutually exclusive with automatic SD updates at startup. Enabling this turns the other option off. When disabled, ordinary update notices stop; mandatory updates are still checked.
设备发生过异常重启，故障记录已保留。: The device restarted unexpectedly. A diagnostic record was retained.
保留最近四次异常复位的原因和程序位置，不包含稿件内容或网络密码。: Keeps the last four abnormal resets and code locations. Manuscript contents and network passwords are excluded.
未捕获详细现场，已记录复位原因。: Detailed crash context unavailable; the reset reason was recorded.
相对于当前速度的播放倍率，正常播放为 x1；快进和回退图标表示方向。: Playback multiplier relative to the current speed; normal playback is x1. Fast-forward and rewind icons indicate direction.
标题居中；日期与时间可同时显示，与播放时间码互斥，显示在左上角。上一篇与下一篇二: The title is centered. Date and time can appear together at the top left, or be replaced by playback timecode. Choose either previous or next manuscript. Loop count appears while looping; next manuscript appears when auto-next is enabled.
当前没有下一篇稿件，无法开启自动播放下一篇。: There is no next manuscript. Auto-next is unavailable.
当前稿件播放结束后，自动播放排序中的下一篇稿件。: Automatically play the next manuscript in the current order after this one finishes.
SD 卡已拔出或不可用，已自动切换到内部存储。: The SD card was removed or became unavailable. Switched to internal storage automatically.
当前浏览器无法联网；本地文件和 SD 卡更新仍可使用。: This browser cannot access the internet. Local-file and SD-card updates remain available.
当前连接设备热点，浏览器未能访问更新服务器；请使用可联网的网络后重试。本地文件和: While connected to the device hotspot, this browser could not reach the update server. Retry with internet access. Local-file and SD-card updates remain available.
更新服务器暂时无法访问，请稍后重试；本地文件和 SD 卡更新仍可使用。: The update server is temporarily unreachable. Try again later. Local-file and SD-card updates remain available.
其他控制端已修改此稿件。当前草稿仍保留，请重新读取后再保存。: Another controller changed this manuscript. Your draft is retained. Reload before saving.
设备尚未重新连接。请连接设备热点或原 Wi-Fi 后重新打开后台。: The device has not reconnected. Join its hotspot or the original Wi-Fi, then reopen the controller.
设备已关机。请连接电源，并按设备的 RST 或重新供电开机。: The device is shut down. Connect power and press RST or reconnect power to start it.
设备已关机。屏幕已关闭，网络和蓝牙仍保持连接，点击开机即可继续使用。: The device is off. Its screen is dark, but network and Bluetooth remain connected. Select Start to continue.
请勿断电或断开连接。: Keep the device powered and connected.
关闭时仅一人可操作提词，其他人只读预览；控制者离开提词页后自动开放控制。开启后允: When off, one person controls playback while others preview. Control transfers when that person leaves the playback page. When on, everyone can control playback. Manuscript editing stays exclusive.
其他控制端正在控制播放，当前仅可预览。对方离开提词页后将自动开放控制。: Another controller is operating playback. Preview only; control becomes available when they leave the playback page.
其他控制端正在控制播放，当前仅可预览。: Another controller is operating playback. Preview only.
其他控制端正在编辑此稿件，当前仅可预览。对方保存或退出后将自动恢复编辑。: Another controller is editing this manuscript. Preview only; editing becomes available when they save or leave.
正在确认编辑权限，当前仅可预览。未保存的草稿仍保留。: Checking editing access. Preview only; your unsaved draft is preserved.
其他控制端正在编辑此稿件，当前仅可预览: Another controller is editing this manuscript. Preview only.
同时编辑的稿件过多，请稍后重试: Too many manuscripts are being edited. Try again shortly.
整页模式不可用；切回滚动模式后恢复原设置。: Unavailable in whole-page mode. Your settings are restored when you return to scrolling.
切换模式会暂停并回到开头；分别保留滚动设置和翻页设置。: Changing modes pauses and returns to the beginning. Scrolling and page settings are retained separately.
仅删除异常重启记录，不影响稿件、设备设置和网络配置。: Only clears restart records. Manuscripts, device settings and network configuration are retained.
将应用当前网络设置，设备可能暂时断开连接。请确认 Wi-Fi 名称、密码和 IP: Applying these settings may briefly disconnect the device. Check the Wi-Fi name, password and IP address.
仅删除内置稿件库中的稿件及其样式，不格式化分区，不删除设备设置、网络配置或 SD: Deletes only internal manuscripts and their styles. The partition, device settings, network configuration and SD card files are retained.
在设备名称后显示当前固件版本；需要同时开启设备名称。: Append the firmware version to the device name. Enable the device name as well.
显示当前时间；与日期可同时开启，与播放时间码互斥。: Show the clock alongside the date, or replace both with playback timecode.
显示当前日期；与时间可同时开启，与播放时间码互斥。: Show the date alongside the clock, or replace both with playback timecode.
显示当前播放状态；播放中显示红色圆点。: Show the playback status, with a red dot while playing.
显示本次提词的播放计时；与日期和时间互斥。: Show elapsed playback time in place of the date and clock.
滚动模式显示播放进度；整页模式显示页码和阅读剩余时间。: Show scroll progress, or the page number and remaining reading time in whole-page mode.
完成一次正文绘制所需的时间。: Time needed to draw a frame of manuscript text.
当前正文的左右边距。: Current manuscript left and right margins.
开始播放前的倒计时；为 0 时隐藏。: Countdown before playback starts. Hidden when set to zero.
现在可以开始提词，或返回首页。: Start prompting now, or return to the library.
滚动模式显示播放进度；整页模式显示阅读剩余时间，页码显示在标题栏右侧。: Scroll mode shows progress. Page mode shows remaining reading time; the page number appears in the right header.
直接切换立即显示下一页；滚动切换以短距离向上滚动过渡。每页阅读结束后自动翻页，暂: Direct switch shows the next page immediately; scroll transition moves upward a short distance. Pages advance after the reading time; use the up/down arrows to turn pages while paused.
滚动模式显示播放进度；整页模式显示页码，阅读剩余时间显示在标题栏右侧。: Scroll mode shows progress; page mode shows the page number, with remaining reading time at the top right.
